description: Missing readings are stored as 0. If so, exactly 0 is far more common than its neighbours, -0.1 and +0.1 C.
action_taken: Not a defect in the file, but every query must treat 0 as missing. Reads go through heat.india_days, where 0 becomes NULL.
detail: India: tempMax = 0 on 60207581 rows, against 1 at +0.1 C and 0 at -0.1 C

description: A zero in precipitation can mean dry or not reported. Compare the Parquet's zeros with NOAA's raw file for temperature stations.
action_taken: Rain results use only stations and periods where reports are complete, never a zero on its own.
detail: Rows on temperature stations 1982-2021: 1136483. NOAA rain reports on those rows: 568808. The difference is rows where 0 rain was never reported.

description: Duplicates: more than one row per station per date, for every Indian station.
action_taken: None found, so no action was needed.

description: Plausibility: tempMin above tempMax on the same day.
action_taken: Days where the minimum exceeds the maximum are dropped from temperature means and thresholds.

description: Plausibility: maximum or minimum outside -10 to 52 C at stations below 1,000 m.
action_taken: The plan's -10 to 52 C bound suits the plains. Readings outside it are real in the hills, so only non-hill stations are flagged.

description: Plausibility: negative rainfall, and any single day above India's 24-hour record of about 1,560 mm.
action_taken: Passes by construction: NOAA's source column has no negative rain, and the column cannot hold one.

description: Repeated readings: maximum identical to the day before. Whole groups of stations jump well above a natural level near 4%.
action_taken: Stations are grouped by when this affected them. Heat counts are reported as recorded, with repeats removed, and at stations never affected.
detail: Share of days repeating the previous maximum: 3.5% in 1982-88, 13.6% in 2011-24

description: Rounding: every maximum from 1973 to 1981 is a whole degree, which moves values across a 40 C cut-off.
action_taken: Threshold questions start in 1982, and a sensitivity test rounds every year to whole degrees.
detail: Whole-degree share of maximums: 100% in 1973-81, 15.6% in 1982-2021

description: Reconciliation: Indian maximums in the Parquet that disagree with NOAA's raw files or are absent from them.
action_taken: The Parquet and NOAA's raw files are compared before the raw files extend the series past September 2022.
detail: 1091508 Parquet maximums compared; 1090649 identical, 97 differ, 762 not in the raw files

description: Source break: NOAA moved Indian stations from its Summary of the Day source to a different one during 2025.
action_taken: Temperature stops at December 2024. Later values come from a different source and are not spliced on.
detail: Maximums from a source other than S: 0 through 2024, 30650 from 2025

description: Coverage: the Parquet stops on 7 September 2022, not at the end of 2022.
action_taken: Annual trends use whole years, and 2022 comes from NOAA's raw files after 7 September.
detail: Last date in the Parquet: 2022-09-07; days short of the end of 2022 are in n
